Basic Information.Supported CPU:
LGA1700 socket: Support for the 14th, 13th, and 12th Generation Intel Core, Pentium Gold and Celeron Processors
L3 cache varies with CPU
Basic Information.BIOS:
1 x 128 Mbit flash
Use of licensed AMI UEFI BIOS
PnP 1.0a, DMI 2.7, WfM 2.0, SM BIOS 2.7, ACPI 5.0
Basic Information.Audio:
Realtek Audio CODEC
High Definition Audio
2/4/5.1/7.1-channel

Expansion Slots.PCI:
CPU:
- 1 x PCI Express x16 slot, supporting PCIe 4.0 and running at x16
* The PCIEX16 slot can only support a graphics card or an NVMe SSD.
Chipset:
- 2 x PCI Express x1 slots, supporting PCIe 3.0 and running at x1

Memory.Maximum Memory: Supporting up to 128 GB (32 GB single DIMM capacity) of system memory

Connector & Ports.LAN Port (s): Realtek GbE LAN chip (1 Gbps/100 Mbps/10 Mbps)
Connector & Ports.Supported Storage:
CPU:
- 1 x M.2 connector (Socket 3, M key, type 2280 PCIe 4.0 x4/x2 SSD support) (M2A_CPU)
Chipset:
- 1 x M.2 connector (Socket 3, M key, type 2280 PCIe 4.0 x4/x2 SSD support) (M2P_SB)
- 4 x SATA 6Gb/s connectors
Connector & Ports.RAID: RAID 0, RAID 1, RAID 5, and RAID 10 support for SATA storage devices
Connector & Ports.TPM (Trusted Platform Module ): 1 x Trusted Platform Module header (For the GC-TPM2.0 SPI/GC-TPM2.0 SPI 2.0 / GC-TPM2.0 SPI V2 module only)

Others.Special Features:
Support for GIGABYTE Control Center (GCC)
Support for Q-Flash
Support for Q-Flash Plus

Norton Internet Security (OEM version)
LAN bandwidth management software
